inspection_method: Rendered every generated PDF page with PyMuPDF at 1.5 scale and inspected each PNG at original detail.
observations: No overlap, cutoff, corrupted glyph, or missing content was visible.
The repaired campaign section uses the neutral CAMPAIGN PERFORMANCE badge while retaining the campaign name and 900 GBP, 2,700 GBP, and 3x values.
Monthly-average wording appears only on the current comparison and product sections, not as a campaign period claim.
GBP and explicit unknown-currency labels are legible in cards, comparison rows, product tables, and campaign tables.
Synthetic names containing ampersands and angle brackets render as literal text.
